'''''Hav''''' was a group of three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Two of the freighters were carrying [[Fusion furnace/Legends|Power units]], while the third one was carrying [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. The one with the warheads was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Mission to Almaran|recon mission]] of the Imperial fleet.

*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]'' {{1st}}
